topic.label: Programming Languages
topic.desc: Programming languages as working skills: Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, C and C++, Java and Kotlin, SQL and shell, with the tooling around each.

concepts: Python code, packaging, typing, testing and async work.
TypeScript types, compiler settings and Node or browser builds.
Go modules, goroutines, channels, testing and tooling.
Rust ownership, lifetimes, cargo, crates and safe interfaces to unsafe code.
C and C++ memory management, build systems and systems programming.
Java and Kotlin build, dependency, concurrency and testing practice on the JVM.
SQL queries, schema design, indexes, migrations and query plans.
Shell scripts that are safe, portable and automatable.
skills: Creates virtual environments, pins dependencies in a lock file and writes packaging metadata so a project installs the same way on another machine.
Adds type hints, runs a static type checker and writes pytest tests with fixtures, reporting which behaviour is still untested.
Writes asyncio code and data-processing pipelines, then profiles them and explains where the time goes.
Sets strict compiler options and designs types, generics and discriminated unions so errors surface at build time.
Configures npm scripts, bundlers and module formats for Node services and browser apps and fixes build failures.
Structures Go modules and writes goroutine and channel code with cancellation, and checks for leaks and races.
Writes table-driven tests, runs vet and the race detector and wires benchmarks into the build.
Explains and fixes borrow-checker errors by redesigning ownership, lifetimes and data structures rather than cloning everything.
Manages Cargo workspaces, features and crate dependencies and runs clippy and tests before release.
Wraps unsafe code and foreign-function interfaces in safe APIs and documents the invariants each unsafe block relies on.
C and C++ Memory and Build
Finds memory errors with sanitizers, applies ownership idioms such as smart pointers and sets up CMake builds.
Designs header files, ABI-stable interfaces and system-call wrappers and checks portability across platforms.
Configures Gradle or Maven builds, resolves dependency conflicts and packages Java and Kotlin artifacts.
Writes thread-safe Java and Kotlin code with coroutines or executors and tests it with unit and integration tests.
Writes joins and aggregates, reads query plans and proposes indexes, showing the plan before and after.
Designs normalized tables and constraints and writes reversible migrations with a plan for existing data.
Writes shell scripts with strict error handling and correct quoting and checks them with a linter before they run.
Builds command pipelines and scheduled jobs for file, log and deployment tasks and says what each job needs permission to touch.
